review.review: The hero stopped alive, not dead. Offline reconstruction of the played source matched decisions 0–1136 and reproduced terminal decision 1137. The initiating stale-route contradiction already appears after decision 1106: a confirmed final scout defeat leaves its immediate escape edge protected, so decision 1107 rejects useful key routing and detours. Later, a revealed summoning trap excludes the key, and another retreat protects the food route. After the final crab defeat, reversal rejection and exhausted recovery end the run. The correction retires only an immediate edge occupied by a newly confirmed sole defeated foe, with strict threat, visibility and status checks. The candidate first diverges at decision 1107; reconstruction stops there. A separate late-state probe correctly retains protection because another stale sighting remains. The new regression fails on original policy and passes on the candidate; all 2058 suite tests pass, with four skipped. This establishes a focused initiating bookkeeping repair, not successful collection, puzzle completion or survival.
review.learnings: A confirmed last pursuer defeat can retire its matching immediate escape edge without declaring the floor clear. Retain unrelated edges and threat memories, and continue requiring actual pickup receipts and independent hazard admission.
